scope: static, diff only; nothing executed; code changes read line by line, documentation text read for malicious content; technical and factual claims not verified; diff scanned for invisible/bidi characters (none); links added in the diff, if any, point only to the project's own GitHub or to official vendor docs (conda, Microsoft Learn)
findings: Two files (runtime/shims/xmem.cpp and runtime/test/xmem_test.cpp). Nothing malicious. The change removes view_protect()'s fallback that mapped pages in PAGE_NOACCESS windows as PAGE_READWRITE, so a page mapped in such a window now stays PAGE_NOACCESS. The removed comment said the D3D12 layer reads such GPU memory on the CPU; if any code path still does, it would now fault, so the maintainer may want to confirm no path relies on the old behavior. A test for the new protections is added.
